about: Recording R0.8 20261022-1227 'rack5' (68.5 s). Checked by eye by Claude from the video before either system was run (1 fps overview; 4-15 fps around the break). Times are seconds from the start of the recording, 'at' = cue strike, about +/-0.3 s. Racking 0-36 s (balls placed by hand), break 45.7 s. The 9 went in on the break, which wins the rack, so the rack is one shot long; the player then walks round and stops recording. Not reviewed by the player.
